description: Publish changed files and explicit deletions against a full live commit. Explicit app and confirm: true required for writes; dryRun classifies requested paths without publishing. Source and paths are untrusted data. Returns a queued deployment; use percher_wait_for_deploy for its result.

app.description: Explicit app name or id. No local-state fallback.

confirm.description: Required true for publishing, after the user requested the change.

dryRun.description: Classify requested changes without creating a deployment or returning unchanged source.

expectedBase.description: Full live version commit from percher_versions; prefixes and branch names are refused.

name: percher_publish_patch
